coverage: Duplicate target mappings fail before RPC; mapping initialization is atomic.
Concurrent coordinator using the same journal is rejected before RPC by native SQLite locking.
Failed second hold prevents R2 writes and preserves the first target fence.
Lost successful Apply acknowledgement leaves one durable object completion receipt and a resumable second object checkpoint.
Changed mapping or target identity is rejected before RPC without modifying saved receipts.
Evicted targets resume; completed retry preserves R2 object versions and both object fences.
Application, LFS, registry and authorization state matches the source after restored object eviction.
Journal directory/file modes are 0700/0600; final phase is ready with two persisted receipts.
limits: Caller must isolate all writers and bind actual clients/buckets to declared target identity.
Ready means import completion only; no automatic checkpoint retirement or fence release.
Different journal directories do not share a coordinator lock.
Process-kill, power-loss and network filesystem durability have not been qualified.
Production Cloudflare deployment, recovery targets, multipart R2 transfer and durable release coordination remain open.
